d:
Abhineta manoj bajpeyi ne apne abhi tak ke ekting kariyar men ek se barhkar ek kirdar nibhae hain. vo bare parde ke sath hi otiti pletform par bhi hit rahe.
Darshakon ne unhen kaphi pasand kiya hai. hal hi men unki film 'gajab rat' otiti par riliz huee hai. iske nirmata niraj pandey hain.
Apne is kirdar, abhinay, phem aur isse juri chunautiyon ko lekar manoj bajpeyi ne bibisi nyuz hindi se bat ki hai. is dauran unke sath niraj pandey bhi the. dekhie bibisi nyuz hindi ke lie stuti ghosh ke sath unki ye khas batchit.
Vidiyo edit: altaf
